title: E-Scooter ER Visits Jumped 260%
hook: E-Scooter ER Visits Jumped 260% In Two Years
closing: Fast adoption needs safety habits and streets that catch up just as quickly.
question: Would you wear a helmet?

segments.say: E-scooter ER visits reached 27,700, turning a convenience trend into a fast-growing injury problem.
Two-thirds of injured riders wore no helmet, making preventable head risk part of the surge.
Cumulative e-scooter ER visits reached 169,300, showing the surge did not end after the first spike.
